resources.string_upd:
About these terms

These terms apply to everyone who visits or uses {site_title} (the "site"). By using the site or signing up for an account, you agree to them. If you do not agree, please do not use the site.

Who runs this site

{site_title} is run by its operator ("we", "us"). We set these terms, decide how they apply and enforce them.

The site is built with UNA, open-source community software made by UNA, Inc. UNA, Inc. does not run this site, is not a party to these terms and has no control over them, over what is posted here or over how we enforce them. Send questions and complaints about the site to us, not to UNA, Inc.

Your account

  • You must be at least 16 years old to sign up, or older if the law where you live sets a higher age.
  • Give accurate information when you sign up and keep it up to date.
  • Keep your password safe. You are responsible for what happens in your account, so tell us straight away if you think someone else has used it.
  • Do not create an account for someone else without their permission.

Your content

You keep the rights to what you post. By posting it, you let us store it, show it to the audience you choose and make the copies that running the site needs. This permission ends when you delete the content or your account, apart from copies that other members have already shared and copies we must keep for a limited time, such as backups.

You are responsible for what you post. Post only what you have the right to share.

Rules

When you use the site, do not:

  • break the law, or help or encourage others to break it;
  • harass, threaten or bully anyone, or attack people for who they are;
  • share other people's private information without their consent;
  • post content that infringes someone else's copyright, trademark or other rights;
  • post anything that sexualises or exploits children;
  • send spam, run scams or pretend to be someone else;
  • upload malware, try to get into accounts or areas you are not allowed to use, collect other members' data without their consent, or disrupt the site.

The community may also have rules of its own, which are shown on the site. They apply too.

Moderation

We may review, hide or remove content, and limit, suspend or close accounts that break these terms or put the site or other people at risk. Where we can, we will tell you what we did and why. To report content or a member, use the Report option on the site or contact us.

Paid features

If the site offers paid memberships or other paid features, the price, what you get and how to cancel are shown before you pay. Renewals and refunds follow the conditions shown when you pay and the law that applies to you.

Other people's content and other sites

Content posted by members belongs to them and does not necessarily reflect our views. Links to other websites are provided for convenience. We are not responsible for those websites.

Closing your account

You can stop using the site at any time and delete your account in your account settings. We may close an account as described under Moderation.

No warranty and limits of liability

We provide the site "as is" and "as available". We work to keep it running and safe, but we cannot promise that it will always be available, free of errors or secure. As far as the law allows, we are not liable for indirect losses or for losses caused by other members' content or actions. Nothing in these terms takes away rights that the law gives you and that cannot be waived.

Changes to these terms

We may update these terms. The current version is always on this page. If a change is significant, we will tell members before it takes effect, for example on the site or by email. If you keep using the site after a change takes effect, you accept the updated terms.

Applicable law

These terms are governed by the law of the country where we are based. If you live in another country, you also keep the protection that its mandatory consumer laws give you.

Contact

For questions about these terms, contact us through the contact details shown on the site.

Who is responsible for your data

{site_title} (the "site") is run by its operator ("we", "us"). We decide what personal data the site collects, why and for how long, and we are responsible for it. Some laws call this role the data controller.

The site is built with UNA, open-source community software made by UNA, Inc. UNA, Inc. does not run this site. Collecting, using and storing personal data here is entirely at our discretion and under our control, not UNA, Inc.'s. Send questions and requests about your data to us.

What we collect

  • Account details: your email address and password, and a phone number if you add one. We do not store your password in readable form.
  • Profile and content: your profile details and pictures, and what you post, comment, react to, follow or join. Who can see each item depends on the privacy settings you choose.
  • Messages: private messages are stored on the site's servers so they can be delivered.
  • Usage and device data: the pages you open and the actions you take, with the time, your IP address, browser, device type and language. Our servers also keep logs of requests and errors.
  • Cookies and local storage: a cookie keeps you signed in, and others remember settings such as language and theme. If you use our mobile app and allow notifications, we keep a device token to send them. If we add services of other companies, such as analytics or advertising, we name them in this policy together with the cookies they set.
  • Payments: if you buy something on the site, a payment provider handles the payment. We get a confirmation, not your full card details.
  • From other people: other members may mention you, tag you or invite you by email.

Why we use it

  • to run your account and show your content to the audience you chose;
  • to send you emails and notifications about your account and activity, which you can turn off in your settings, except for essential ones such as password resets;
  • to send you news about the site, only if you agreed to receive it;
  • to keep the site safe: to stop spam, abuse and fraud and to handle reports;
  • to understand how the site is used and improve it;
  • to meet our legal obligations.

Where the law requires a legal basis for using personal data, we rely on our agreement with you (the Terms of Service), our legitimate interest in running a safe and useful site, your consent (which you can withdraw at any time), and our legal obligations.

Who can see it

  • Other members and visitors see your profile and posts as your privacy settings allow.
  • Service providers that help us run the site, such as hosting, storage, email delivery and payment providers, process data for us and only to provide their service.
  • Authorities get data when the law requires it, or when it is needed to protect someone's rights or safety.
  • A new operator gets the data if the site is transferred to someone else, and this policy continues to apply.

We do not sell your personal data and do not share it for advertising.

Our servers and service providers may be in countries other than yours. Where the law requires it, data sent there is protected by the safeguards that law sets out, such as standard contractual clauses.

How long we keep it

We keep your account data and content for as long as your account exists. When you delete your account, we delete your profile and delete or anonymise your content within 30 days, apart from what the law requires us to keep. Copies in backups are deleted within 90 days. Server logs are kept for up to 90 days.

Your rights

  • Access and copy: you can ask us what data we hold about you and for a copy of it.
  • Correction: you can correct most of your data yourself in your profile and account settings, or ask us to.
  • Deletion: you can delete your content, or your whole account in your account settings.
  • Objection and consent: you can object to some uses of your data and withdraw any consent you gave, for example by unsubscribing from emails.

To use these rights, contact us. We may need to confirm your identity first. Depending on where you live, you may also be able to complain to your data protection authority.

Security

We take reasonable steps to protect your data, such as limiting who can access it. No system is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee it. Use a strong password that you do not use anywhere else. If a breach affects your data, we will tell you where the law requires us to.

Children

The site is not meant for children under 16. We do not knowingly collect their data. If you believe a child has given us personal data, contact us and we will delete it.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy. The current version is always on this page. If a change is significant, we will tell members before it takes effect, for example on the site or by email.

Contact

For questions or requests about your data, contact us through the contact details shown on the site.

Studio is where you set up your site. This short tour shows the apps to start with. You can start it again from your account menu.
Set the logo, pick a template and edit the cover page that guests see first.
Manage member accounts and choose who is an operator or a moderator. Moderators look after content and profiles on the site itself, not in Studio.
Add, remove and rearrange blocks on any page, or create new pages. Visibility and SEO settings are here too.
Edit the menus: add, reorder and hide links, change icons and choose who sees each item.
UNA starts with the core apps. Get more here: modules, templates, languages and integrations.
